subject: Evidence connector: SFTP vs API mapping and legacy docs ingestion
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@corehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@corehealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

Hi Vivek,

We're starting a revalidation for Redwood in our vendor portal (Vendr) and have a mix of legacy artifacts stored in S3 and a CSV manifest that lists historical SOC 2 snippets and configuration screenshots. Before we open the profile in Vendr, can you confirm: 1) whether Vendr's evidence connector can pull artifacts via SFTP/S3 or if we should push via their API, and 2) whether partial documents (PDF excerpts) are acceptable for the CAIQ mapping?

For context, I've attached a small manifest extracted from our platform and a short SOC 2 excerpt. Goal is to avoid re-creating 200+ entries manually.

Attachments: legacy-evidence-manifest.csv (csv), soc2-excerpt-2026.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Vendor Risk Manager
CoreHealth

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@corehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

Hi Maria — thanks for the manifest, that's helpful. Quick answer up front: Vendr supports both push (API) and connector-based ingest (S3/SFTP) for bulk artifacts, but implementations vary by field mapping.

High-level plan:
- I'll coordinate a short mapping doc that compares your CSV columns to Vendr evidence fields.
- Priyom will validate which artifacts can be attached as "excerpts" vs full documents for CAIQ questions.
- Marissa can lead the upload if we go with a manual push or run the initial connector sync once we confirm paths.

Priyom/Marissa: can one of you run a quick scan of the manifest and confirm any required renames or missing metadata (timestamps, control IDs)? If we can get a clean manifest, we can either: (A) configure Vendr's SFTP connector to pull the S3 export, or (B) call the Vendr API to push attachments programmatically. Both will need a small mapping JSON and a single one-off upload job.

Vivek
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

Thanks Vivek — I pulled the CSV and ran a quick pass. Notes: 
- The manifest has columns: file_key, control_ref, uploaded_by, uploaded_at, sha256. We'll need an additional column for question_id (CAIQ) or tag mapping.
- Many of the PDF files in S3 are multi-page reports; Vendr accepts PDF excerpts, but when you attach an excerpt you should include a short note indicating which pages map to which control.
- For automation: Vendr's API accepts multipart/form-data attachments with metadata; easier route if we need per-question metadata. SFTP connector works for bulk binary files but requires consistent directory layout.

Recommendation: create a small mapping CSV (file_key -> question_id -> pages) and add a metadata.json next to each file for the connector route. If the customer can add the question_id column, we'll do the API push and annotate each attachment with the CAIQ mapping.

I can generate a sample mapping and a short script to translate the legacy manifest into the Vendr format. ETA: 3 business days if no surprises.

--
Priyom Das
Security Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

I've got bandwidth to run the initial upload once Priyom prepares the mapping. Two operational caveats: 
- If we use the API route, we'll need a service account from CoreHealth with a scoped key (short lived preferred).
- If we use SFTP, they'll need to stage files in a consistent prefix (e.g., /corehealth/2027-05-manifest/). We should provide a checksum verification step post-sync.

I also prepared a short internal playbook (vendr-connector-setup.md) outlining the steps, permission matrix, and rollback actions. I'll attach it to the final handoff.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@corehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

Hi team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We can add a question_id column to the manifest and stage the files in S3 under the prefix you suggested. We prefer the SFTP/connector route because we don't want to provision programmatic access keys yet.

Two asks: 
1) Can Redwood validate the manifest and produce a small report of unmatched files (any file_key not present in our S3 export)?
2) Can you confirm if partial PDFs are acceptable for CAIQ mapping (e.g., pages 3-6 of a 12-page report)?

We'll provision the staged prefix by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Maria

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@corehealth.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor evidence migration: what can be imported into Vendr?

Maria — great, thanks for staging. Quick summary and next steps: 
- Priyom will run the manifest validation and produce an "unmatched files" report by Fri 2027-05-28 12:00 PDT.
- Marissa will kick off the Vendr SFTP connector sync once checksums are confirmed. She'll run an initial dry-run and share the vendr-connector-setup.md playbook.
- Partial PDFs are acceptable if tagged with page ranges; we will include the page-range metadata in Vendr so the evidence viewer points to the relevant pages.

Attachments: vendr-connector-setup.md (md)

I'll also open SEC-482 in Jira for traceability and include the mapping output there. If anything changes, ping me and I'll escalate.

Thanks all — will follow up after the dry-run.

Vivek
